summary: TypeSafe Jev advisory routing, private routing-outcomes ledger, best-effort spawn/teardown logging, and compact-adviser removal all behaved as intended under targeted live and executable tests.
testing_summary: Ran tests/fm-routing-outcomes.test.sh and the full tests/fm-dispatch-resolve.test.sh suite (including Jev effort advisory clipping), then drove real fm-spawn.sh and fm-teardown.sh with a PATH-stubbed failing python3 so ledger failures only warn. Confirmed compact-adviser symbols are gone from bin/ and tests. Evidence logs are in this evidence directory.

scenarios.name: Operator dispatches a task: launch event lands once in data/routing-outcomes.jsonl with qualification fields and no brief text
Typed dispatch resolves a matched rule whose profile omits effort: Jev suggested effort is visible but clipped to rule ceiling/floor
scenarios.evidence: tests/fm-dispatch-resolve.test.sh — Jev effort is advisory and clipped by rule ceiling and floor

scenarios.name: Firstmate spawns a worker when advisory routing ledger append fails: spawn still succeeds with repair warning
Firstmate tears down a scout when routing outcome finalize fails: teardown still completes and backlog closes
compact-adviser removed: no COMPACT_ADVISER / compact-adviser references in bin or tests
